A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Arabidopsis HSP70 homologs, which are targeted to chloroplasts, are processed by stromal processing enzymes into mature forms, which are localized in the stoma.
Arabidopsis Hsps70-6 and -7, but not AtHsp70.8, are processed in chloroplasts.

the precursor forms of AtHsp71-6 and At Hsp70-7 are processed differently in the stroma, and the smaller processed form may be produced by an unidentified peptidase.
